---
title: "1. Samples"
params:
  run_dir: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("_setup.R", local = TRUE)
samples <- prepDNAm::qc_table_samples(rd)
```

Every sample of the run with its QC metrics. `removed` samples are dropped before normalisation; `reasons` are `excluded` (listed by the user), `low_intensity` (median methylated or unmethylated log2 intensity below `r cfg$intensity_threshold`) and `failed_probes` (more than `r 100 * cfg$failed_probe_threshold`% of probes with detection p > `r cfg$detp_threshold`). The table can be filtered and exported.

```{r}
cols <- c("basename", "batch", "removed", "reasons", "mMed", "uMed", "frac_failed_probes", "rho",
          "snp_outlier", "n_missing", "predicted_sex")
extra <- setdiff(names(samples), c(cols, "path", "exclude", "xMed", "yMed", "pheno_path", "pheno_dir"))
tab <- samples[, c(intersect(cols, names(samples)), extra)]
t <- qc_table(tab, round_cols = c("mMed", "uMed", "rho", "snp_outlier"))
if ("frac_failed_probes" %in% names(tab)) t <- DT::formatSignif(t, "frac_failed_probes", 2)
t |> DT::formatStyle("removed", target = "row", backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(TRUE, "#fdecea"))
```

## Metrics

* **mMed / uMed**: median log2 intensity of methylated / unmethylated signal (raw). Low values indicate poor hybridisation or degraded DNA.
* **frac_failed_probes**: fraction of probes with detection p-value above threshold.
* **rho**: signal-to-noise estimate from the type II beta distribution (page 3).
* **snp_outlier**: `ewastools` SNP outlier metric (log odds; values above about &minus;4 suggest contamination or mixed samples).
* **n_missing**: values imputed for the sample after masking failed probes (retained samples only).
* **predicted_sex**: from chrX / chrY intensities (page 5).
